saved: The squeeze concern was borne out. Price rose a further 27.5% against the short by hour 13, worth about 170% of margin, before reversing. The reasons were sound: the crowd had flipped to shorts, top t
notes: This was a short on a coin up 215% in 24h. The trade went against first, then in favour, and touched neither target nor floor. The profit came from the time-limit exit at nearly the best point, which the dossier could not foresee. The cited risks were real and showed up in the path, so the skip was not refused on an empty reason. A single case is not enough to support a lesson.
